entities.summary: Diontae Lamarcus Johnson is an American professional football wide receiver. He played college football for the Toledo Rockets and was selected by the Pittsburgh Steelers in the third round of the 2019 NFL draft. He has also played for the Carolina Panthers, Baltimore Ravens, Houston Texans, and Cleveland Browns.
